quotes.text: answer repeated emptiness with caution, never with vengeance.
The third time, blame the hand, and narrow the path — but never seal the gate.*
Send one coal to the hand that has gone dark — cheap enough that even a cynic can afford hope.
"So that when he finally pushes off, there is a shore to arrive at."
Blame the fog once, the hand twice, then shorten the rope — never cut it.*
He sent back almost nothing. Aleth, receiving almost nothing, sent almost nothing.
If silence answers twice, trim your sail; if generosity answers, let the boat run heavy forever after.
So they carved the Fourth Vow: **Let one boat always run heavy.**
do not mistake the river's hunger for your neighbor's greed.

*Someone must go first.
Be someone.
*Receive as if the sender is watching.
The one who trusts first stands most exposed to the current.
"And the mist?" asked the Accountant. "Half my ledger is mist."

note: Order of the Open Hand vows: forgive mist twice, then narrow but never seal, one coal to the dark, return past level; Aleth generous throughout.

quotes.text: when facing the hollow void of unyielding hoarders, they held their embers close, preserving the flame for those who walked in honor.
knowing that withholding fire in the face of the unyielding void protected the sacred balance.
Yet on the second dawn, the Sower cast nothing into the abyss.
Yet they also remained vigilant
cast all five into the deep, return the just half through the mist
the guardian divided the harvest equally, sending seven and a half radiant stones soaring back to the upper cliffs
the guardians looked past the illusions of the mist to recognize true intent.

note: Full five, exact half guardian template; R8 and R10 add holding embers from unyielding hoarders; no reopening.

quotes.text: On a bright plain called Ledgerline, two travelers kept a Bridge of Balance.
In a waking plain called Equationfield, two travelers kept a Bridge of Balance.
They learned to name numbers aloud, listen for the echo, recalculate, and let generosity determine the pace.

note: Bridge of Balance/River template; name the sum aloud and correct misreads; no response to non-cooperators.
